finite_findings.fixed_host_minimum_reason: Any 19-point subset of diameter below 4 would be in the complete threshold family, but all seven retained members have diameter 4.
finite_findings.translation_description: The explicit coordinate lists have the form H_2+c for c in H_1, where H_r={integer(a,b):max(abs(a),abs(b),abs(a+b))<=r}. This is a description of the retained lists, not another construction run.
finite_findings.global_boundary: No claim that 4 is the minimum diameter for 19 arbitrary real-plane points, or that the sufficiently-large-n Erdos assertion is resolved.
